nodes.name: cluster-bootstrap.ts
nodes.summary: Implements cluster-bootstrap confidence interval computation for benchmark statistics, grouping evaluation rows by conversation cluster and resampling with a seeded Mulberry32 PRNG to produce robust percentile-based CIs that account for intra-cluster correlation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a self-contained seeded PRNG (mulberry32) to ensure reproducible bootstrap results without external dependencies.

nodes.name: computeClusterBootstrapCI
nodes.summary: Computes a bootstrap confidence interval for a proportion by resampling whole clusters (conversations) with replacement to correctly account for intra-cluster correlation in multi-turn evaluation data.

nodes.name: wilson-ci.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the Wilson score confidence interval formula for benchmark accuracy proportions, exporting both the main `computeWilsonCI` function and the `Z_95_TWO_SIDED` constant used for 95% two-sided intervals.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Wilson score interval analytically (no resampling), making it fast and suitable for single-pass accuracy reporting.

nodes.name: computeWilsonCI
nodes.summary: Computes a Wilson score confidence interval for a success proportion given successes, total trials, and a z-score, returning lower and upper bounds clamped to [0, 1].

nodes.name: cluster-bootstrap.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for `computeClusterBootstrapCI`, covering input validation, deterministic reproducibility via seeding, cluster-level resampling correctness, and edge cases such as single-item clusters and extreme correctness rates.

nodes.name: wilson-ci.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for `computeWilsonCI`, verifying the Wilson score interval formula against known values, input validation guards, and boundary conditions including zero and full success rates.
